title: Daily 09:00 job drifts an hour across the spring DST transition
source: Authored for the CodeReview benchmark corpus (generation-v3 defect-injected stratum), 2026-11-05

expected.title: Next daily run is computed by adding a fixed 24 hours of elapsed time to a local wall time, so after spring-forward the job fires at 10:00 local instead of 09:00
